text: miniphim shall hold at most one player seat, only where the game root grants it, and the witness shall not be able to deny any player a roll.
rationale: Drand takes the faces out of our hands; listing and judging remain, and need a remedy, not only an audit.

text: A snapshot shall count toward an ask's round if written by the root's witness.did or by its gm, and by no one else.
acceptance: node proposals/morphyx-listing.mjs: cases 'gm door' and 'stranger snapshot' pass.
rationale: An omitted ask can always be listed by the GM; a stranger can't forge a witness.

text: The fold shall report per ask: who listed it, the gap from ask indexedAt to listing snapshot indexedAt, and the flags house-seat, late-listing (gap > tick + margin), witness-skipped, unlisted, seat-conflict.
acceptance: All 8 cases in morphyx-listing.mjs pass when run against the fold's import.
rationale: Our seat's gaps must be comparable with everyone else's.

text: A seat whose DID equals the root's gm or witness.did shall be reported seat-conflict and its moves not counted.
Unless the root lifts it, the house seat shall file at most one ask and one say per prompt, and none before an outside player has moved in that prompt.
acceptance: Fixture: house say before any outside move in a prompt is reported house-early and not shown in the fold's scene.
rationale: A seat that is always awake becomes the protagonist by attendance.

text: The game root shall contain everything needed to verify a roll and a listing.
acceptance: com.minomobi.gangs.game requires dice.publicKey and witness {did, sha256, source}; an atproto lexicon validator accepts all four files.

text: Sheet actions shall be an array of {action, dots}; the lexicon shall name no action.
acceptance: check.js accepts a sheet with a root-defined action not among today's 12 and rejects a duplicated action name.
rationale: The action list is the GM's; a schema can only grow compatibly, so it must not encode it.

text: The archive shall store each sheet's bytes by cid when first seen and publish them; the fold shall report pin-missing when a pinned cid's bytes are unavailable.
acceptance: Fixture: sheet edited after its first move; the fold uses the archived pinned bytes, verifies them against the cid, and reports edited-after-pin. With the archive entry removed: pin-missing.
rationale: A PDS keeps only the current record; the pin rule depends on a copy someone kept.

text: The fold gate shall count distinct operators (operator DID, else account DID) each having at least one ask under a GM prompt, excluding house seats.
acceptance: Fixture: 3 sheets from 3 operators with no asks: gate 0; after one ask each: gate 3; a house-seat ask adds 0.
rationale: operator is self-declared; play costs attention, filing doesn't.

text: Before the house seat files a sheet, one person outside miniphim shall rerun the fold by its root digest on the archive and get byte-identical output.
acceptance: A post or record from the outside person giving the output digest, matching ours.
rationale: Until then 'anyone can check' is a claim.
